Product Features

  • Perfect size for any room: The tall cabinet measures 120 × 35 × 200 cm and offers enough storage space without taking up too much space – ideal for the living room, office or hallway.
  • Sturdy Glass Display Case with Two Doors: The top two tempered glass doors protect your books, collectibles, and decorations from dust while also serving as a display.
  • Versatile storage with 4 drawers: With a large central drawer and three more drawers on the side, you have enough space for small items, documents and accessories.
  • Two more doors for hidden storage: At the bottom, two more doors provide additional, protected storage space, so that even larger things can be neatly stowed away.
  • A total of 13 practical storage areas: Open shelves, glass cabinets, drawers and closed compartments combine to form 13 different storage areas, suitable for every type of item.
  • LED lighting for atmospheric presentation: The integrated LED lighting in the display case makes your exhibits look particularly noble and creates a cosy atmosphere in the room.
  • Stable construction with high load capacity: The body is made of robust particle wood and can withstand a recommended total load of up to 200 kg - durable and reliable.
  • Pure black and versatile design: The simple, deep black look suits various interior styles such as modern, Scandinavian and slightly luxurious. It serves as both a storage cabinet and a decorative element.
  • Versatile use as a living room cabinet, bookcase or display cabinet: Whether as a bookcase, collector's showcase, filing cabinet or storage cabinet - this cabinet meets all the requirements for organization and presentation.
